title: JWT Authentication
description: Implement JSON Web Token authentication in ASP.NET Core APIs.

data.text: `JSON Web Tokens (JWT)` are compact, URL-safe tokens used for securely transmitting claims between parties. In ASP.NET Core, `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer` validates incoming JWT tokens and populates `HttpContext.User`.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install the JWT Bearer authentication package.

data.text: Register JWT Bearer authentication in `Program.cs` by providing the token validation parameters.

data.title: JWT Configuration
data.content: Configure JWT Bearer authentication in Program.cs.

data.text: Create a login endpoint that generates a JWT using `JwtSecurityTokenHandler` and signs it with your secret key.

data.title: Token Generation
data.content: Generate a JWT after validating user credentials.

terms.definition: The default authentication scheme name for JWT Bearer.
Configuration for validating issuer, audience, lifetime, and signature.
The class used to create and write JWT tokens.

data.title: Warning
data.text: Never hardcode JWT secrets in code. Use environment variables or a secret manager. Use strong, randomly generated keys with at least 32 characters.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Claims in the token become HttpContext.User claims
Always validate issuer, audience, and signing key
data.takeaway: JWT Bearer authentication provides stateless, scalable API security for ASP.NET Core.
